_finding: The outside review (21.11) read 415 tokens beside 90 price readings as 22% coverage. Wherever the site counts tokens it must say what the count is out of: the issuer's list, and of it the minted tokens, the only ones with a price to read. Where the issuer reports no supply the minted count is null, never a guess.

mutations.name: the board does not say how many are minted
mutations.expect: FAIL the board says how many the issuer lists

mutations.name: a missing supply reads as minted
mutations.find: m.length && m.every((x) => x != null) ? m.filter(Boolean).length : null
mutations.expect: FAIL the board says how many the issuer lists

mutations.name: an unminted token counts as minted
mutations.expect: FAIL ...an unminted token is listed and not minted
